title: AI Productivity Impact Diagnostic | GAINS by Faros

hero.headline: GAINS™ — prepare your engineering workforce for AI-powered excellence
hero.subhead: Partner with us to build a concrete plan for your engineering organization's next steps.

sections.heading: The challenge
sections.body: Page claim: '$40B invested in GenAI, yet only 5% of enterprises see measurable returns' — the AI Productivity Paradox. Barriers: no clear strategy, teams working alone, infrastructure lag, can't measure success.

stats.label: of enterprises see measurable returns (page claim)

sections.heading: GAINS = Generative AI Impact Net Score
sections.body: A diagnostic to benchmark AI maturity, identify organizational friction, and tie AI usage to engineering and business outcomes. Names tools: Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Augment, Devin.
named_capabilities: GAINS — Generative AI Impact Net Score

sections.heading: The diagnostic — three steps
sections.body: 1) Where are you today? (baseline measurement + root cause). 2) Discover the art of the possible (benchmark vs leaders, quantify ROI of each intervention). 3) Unlock AI's potential in 90 days (team-specific action plan, KPIs mapping AI performance to business outcomes).

sections.heading: Our solution — ten transformation dimensions
sections.body: Uses interviews, surveys, and live SDLC telemetry to measure adoption/usage, velocity/flow efficiency, quality/safety, onboarding/platform maturity, org structure/strategic alignment. Each dimension linked to business performance — a shared metric aligning engineering and finance.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. GAINS is a named, trademarked framework/diagnostic (Generative AI Impact Net Score) referenced by the AI Transformation capability — worth its own node. Part service/engagement (interviews + 90-day plan), part product (telemetry). The '$40B / 5%' figures are page marketing claims (echoing the MIT NANDA 95%-no-impact stat already in offering.json proof); captured as-stated. Aligns engineering + finance = the door/room positioning at the org level.
